<?php
// Test store only. Skips the WooCommerce setup wizard, keeps every email inside the store, and lets a
// logged-in admin run the scripts in the plugin's tests folder: /wp-admin/admin-post.php?action=ioefw_dev&script=run
add_filter( 'woocommerce_enable_setup_wizard', '__return_false' );
add_filter( 'woocommerce_prevent_automatic_wizard_redirect', '__return_true' );
add_filter(
	'pre_wp_mail',
	function ( $sent, $mail ) {
		$log   = (array) get_option( 'ioefw_test_mail', array() );
		$log[] = array(
			'to'      => $mail['to'],
			'subject' => $mail['subject'],
			'message' => $mail['message'],
		);
		update_option( 'ioefw_test_mail', array_slice( $log, -20 ), false );
		return true;
	},
	10,
	2
);
add_action(
	'admin_post_ioefw_dev',
	function () {
		$script = isset( $_GET['script'] ) ? sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['script'] ) ) : '';
		$file   = WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/ioefw-tests/' . $script . '.php';
		if ( ! current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) || ! in_array( $script, array( 'seed', 'run', 'storage', 'email' ), true ) || ! is_readable( $file ) ) {
			wp_die( 'Forbidden' );
		}
		if ( 'email' !== $script ) {
			header( 'Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8' );
		}
		require $file;
		exit;
	}
);
